name: Abdominal Aorta
description: Continuation of the descending thoracic aorta below the aortic hiatus (T12). Major branches: celiac trunk, SMA, renal arteries, IMA. Bifurcates into common iliac arteries at L4. On CT: assess diameter (aneurysm >3 cm), mural thrombus, calcification, dissection, and branch vessel patency.
